AXIOM · qeva:1:axiom-pairing@1

Axiom of pairing

For any two sets, a set exists whose members are exactly those two sets.

editorialset-theory · foundations
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

For any two sets, a set exists whose members are exactly those two sets.

EXACT

The compact statement

∀a∀b∃p∀x[x∈p↔(x=a∨x=b)].

Example

Pairing a with itself yields the singleton {a}.

Boundary / caveat

The axiom guarantees an unordered pair; ordered pairs require an additional encoding.

Assumptions

  • The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.
